text:
THE BOARDING SCHOOL

In 2014, we relocated back to Bharat. In 2015, my son cleared the entrance exam of India's best boarding school. Those days, money was not an issue

The Bags were packed, ticket books and the next Morning was our flight to school

I went to bed after packing my Laptop, and suddenly a tear dropped on my arm. I switched on the lights and saw my wife in tears. Asked her what happened

She said, He is too small. How will he manage? Who will I hug every day, who will play carrom, chess and monopoly with me? What will I do in life without him? I didn't say anything, anyway, he needs to leave after 12th, till then, can't I have a meaningful life

Went to my desk, took out my Laptop, cancelled tickets, hotel booking and wrote an apology email to the school that my son will not be joining the Boarding 

This was my best decision in life

Today, this young man is scaling in life all alone with confidence, talks to us every day and is growing out of my shadow

PLEASE, unless u have some real reason, do not send your kids to Boarding

And please do not give the excuse that there are no good schools in our place. Even the poorest kids in villages are cracking top exams without any coaching. It is all about your involvement

Kids do not need Gucci, Prada, iPhone, LV kind of brand, do not buy them for the Brand and status. They need you, hug them, play with them, make them feel an important part of the Family, involve them in family decision making, cook together, eat together. Remember, the day they stop telling you stories after coming from school, something is wrong in the Relationship, and if the daily stories continue when they are in college or a job, rest assured, the relationship is rock solid

The first 18 years of a child's life are the most beautiful years for any parent. 

Early marriage, early kids, graceful ageing and enjoying romance when kids are well placed early. Free yourself from family responsibilities by or before 50. Rest assured, after that, life is full of effortless romance

I am saying this because, unknowingly, we achieved it and are proud of it. Now situation is that I search reason to get busy, and my way is my classes and trying to teach the young generation

A child is born storyteller, but we parents kill that natural skill

Now go hug your kids, today is Sunday, spend time with them and remember, evening after dinner, go out with them for an ice cream

And please do not compare Boarding school with Gurukul. Both are different from head to toe. Only a half-baked mind compares them
